sentences.l2: 音乐的历史很长，记谱法也在慢慢发展。
sentences.l1: The history of music is long, and musical notation is also slowly developing.

sentences.l2: 最早的音乐没有固定的记法，人们靠耳朵学习。
sentences.l1: The earliest music had no fixed way of being written, and people learned by ear.

sentences.l2: 后来，作曲家需要把自己的音乐写下来，让更多人可以演奏。
sentences.l1: Later, composers needed to write their music down so that more people could play it.

sentences.l2: 于是，不同的记谱法出现了。
sentences.l1: So, different notation systems appeared.

sentences.l2: 在古代，有些地方用字母表示音高，有些用符号。
sentences.l1: In ancient times, some places used letters to represent pitch, and some used symbols.

sentences.l2: 这些方法简单，但不能准确记录节奏和长短。
sentences.l1: These methods were simple, but could not accurately record rhythm and note length.

sentences.l2: 随着音乐理论的进步，记谱法变得更精细。
sentences.l1: With the progress of music theory, notation became more refined.

sentences.l2: 欧洲中世纪出现了线谱的早期形式。
sentences.l1: An early form of staff notation appeared in medieval Europe.

sentences.l2: 刚开始只有两条线，后来变成五条线，能更清楚地表示音的高低。
sentences.l1: At first there were only two lines, and later it became five lines, which could show the height of notes more clearly.

sentences.l2: 这种记谱法被很多作曲家使用，也传到了其他地区。
sentences.l1: This notation was used by many composers, and also spread to other regions.

sentences.l2: 虽然各地有不同习惯，但是五线谱慢慢成为国际通用的方法。
sentences.l1: Although different places have different habits, the five-line staff slowly became the internationally common method.

sentences.l2: 在中国，古代也有自己的记谱方式，比如工尺谱和减字谱。
sentences.l1: In China, there were also notation methods of their own in ancient times, such as gongchi notation and jianzi notation.

sentences.l2: 它们用汉字或符号记录指法和音位，适合传统乐器。
sentences.l1: They use Chinese characters or symbols to record fingering and note positions, and suit traditional instruments.

sentences.l2: 虽然今天学习西方五线谱的人很多，但这些古老方法仍有价值。
sentences.l1: Although many people today learn Western five-line staff notation, these ancient methods are still valuable.

sentences.l2: 研究它们可以帮助我们理解音乐的历史。
sentences.l1: Studying them can help us understand the history of music.

sentences.l2: 现代技术还带来了新的记谱方式。
sentences.l1: Modern technology has also brought new ways of notation.

sentences.l2: 有些作曲家使用图形谱，把音乐画成图像。
sentences.l1: Some composers use graphic scores, drawing music as images.

sentences.l2: 也有人用数字软件直接编辑声音。
sentences.l1: Others use digital software to edit sound directly.

sentences.l2: 这些新方法让音乐创作更自由。
sentences.l1: These new methods make musical creation freer.

sentences.l2: 总的来看，记谱法的发展反映了人类对音乐表达的不断追求。
sentences.l1: Overall, the development of notation reflects humanity's constant pursuit of musical expression.

sentences.l2: 从简单符号到复杂系统，它帮助音乐跨越时间与空间，被更多人理解和演奏。
sentences.l1: From simple symbols to complex systems, it has helped music cross time and space, and be understood and played by more people.
